content: आवृत् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To turn round, revolve. .²2 To return, come or turn back; धेनुराववृते वनात् <ls>R. 1. 82</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 19</ls>; एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः <ls>Bg. 8. 26</ls>. .²3 To go to or towards. .²4 To be restless or uneasy; रणरणकविवृद्धिं बिभ्रदावर्तमानम् <ls>Māl. 1. 41</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to turn or revolve; अक्षवलयमावर्तयन्तम् <ls>K. 42</ls> telling the beads. .²2 To roll, turn about or over. .²3 To cause to roll down, shed (as tears <ab>&c.</ab>). .²4 To attract, win over (see आवृज्). .²5 To repeat, recite; आवरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः <ls>Av. 9. 10. 11</ls>.

आवृत् {%f.%} .²1 Causing to turn towards. .²2 Turning towards or round; entering. .²3 Order, succession, method, mode, manner; अनयैवावृता कार्यं पिण्डनिर्वपणं सुतैः <ls>Ms. 3. 248</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 2</ls>. .²4 Progress of an action; occurrence. .²5 Turn of a path, course, direction. .²6 A purificatory rite; अमन्त्रिका तु कार्येयं स्त्रीणामावृदशेषतः <ls>Ms. 2. 66</ls>.
